The CobbLinc app is a one-stop-shop app for Cobb's Microtransit and Paratransit services. 

Microtransit 

CobbLinc Go is a new on-demand microtransit transit service tailored to improve access in South Cobb, across Austell, Powder Springs, and southwestern Marietta. The service will operate in one large service area comprising the previous three FLEX zones. Commute, run errands, connect to the route 25 & 30 bus lines, and more, all on your schedule. The service is a part of a two-year pilot program to enhance public transportation in South Cobb.

Book a microtransit ride in the CobbLinc app or call us a few minutes before you're ready to leave. We'll pick you up and drop you off steps from your door. When you ride, you'll be grouped with others headed in the same direction. Wheelchair accessible vehicles are available.

Paratransit
CobbLinc's Paratransit Service is a shared-ride, curb-to-curb service for customers with disabilities who are not able to use the regular bus service (also called "fixed route") for some or all of their trips because of a disability or other limitations. CobbLinc provides Paratransit Service through a contract with Transdev, but monitors and oversees all aspects of the service. Connect to shopping, social events, medical appointments, hospitals, jobs, and more around Cobb County with our free app, CobbLinc.
 
Paratransit service is provided Monday through Sunday and the daily operating hours are comparable to CobbLinc's local bus service hours. The service area for CobbLinc's Paratransit Service covers a three-quarter (¾) mile radius around the existing local bus routes in Cobb County and limited areas in Fulton County. 

Please call CobbLinc to book your trip up to 3 days in advance, and receive trip reminders and updates on vehicle arrival time. The reservationist will let you know your 30 minute pickup window for when the vehicle will arrive. You are expected to be ready at any time during that pickup window. On the day before your trip, you will receive an automated call or text reminder for each trip you have scheduled.
 
When our vehicle is near your location on the day of the trip, we will send you an automated call or text notification. When your driver arrives, they will wait up to 6 minutes at your pickup location. If they arrive early, they will wait until the start of your pickup window, and then wait another 6 minutes.
 
There may be others on board, and you may make some additional stops before you reach your desired destination. You can track your ride and share your status in real-time from the app.  
 
Our vehicles are wheelchair accessible and are operated by specially trained drivers. Whether you want to run an errand, visit a friend, or need reliable transit to recurring events (work, appointments, etc.), CobbLinc will get you there!
 
  
Questions? Reach out at 770-429-4444

METRO Connect is Rock Region METRO’s on-demand microtransit service.


WHY MICROTRANSIT?
For certain service areas, including areas of emerging or low transit demand, microtransit does a better job of meeting transit demand than a full-size bus operating on a fixed route. Microtransit allows Rock Region METRO to provide on-demand, shared transit rides using smaller vehicles within a set zone, during regular operating hours, via its METRO Connect on-demand service.

BENEFITS TO RIDERS
METRO Connect offers:
• POINT-TO-POINT SERVICE: METRO Connect on-demand microtransit service takes riders from a point within the zone to any other point within the zone.
• AFFORDABLE FARES: A METRO Connect trip is more affordable than trips using traditional Transportation Network Companies, as METRO Connect is part of the Rock Region METRO publicly funded public transit service.
• NEW PLACES: METRO Connect access central Arkansas destinations that have not previously been served by non-paratransit public transit service.

HOW TO USE METRO CONNECT MICROTRANSIT SERVICE
Download the METRO Connect app to schedule ride-hailing trips occurring within a set microtransit zone, during regular METRO Connect zone operating hours (hours vary per zone). Each zone allows riders to travel from point-to-point within the zone to access destinations, including additional METRO transit service, such as fixed bus routes. Find METRO Connect microtransit zone maps, zone hours of operations and connecting fixed routes at rrmetro.org. Standard METRO fares apply.

It blends the convenience of ride-hailing apps with the affordability and eco-consciousness of public transit, making it an attractive option for a wide range of commuters.

Key Features and Benefits:

1. On-Demand
The cornerstone of this microtransit service is its on-demand functionality. Through a user-friendly mobile app, riders can request rides at their convenience, specifying their location and destination. The system intelligently matches multiple passengers with similar routes, reducing the number of individual vehicle trips and optimizing the use of resources. Users are no longer constrained by rigid timetables or designated bus stops; instead, they can book rides at any time and be picked up from the curb in front of their location.

2. Shared Mobility and Affordable
A major advantage of microtransit is its ability to pool riders heading in the same direction. The app groups users together into a shared ride, lowering the overall cost for passengers. The service employs advanced algorithms and AI to optimize routing in real time. As new ride requests come in, the system recalibrates routes to minimize detours while maximizing vehicle occupancy. This dynamic routing ensures that no vehicle operates empty and travel times are kept as short as possible. The algorithms consider traffic patterns, rider demand, and other variables to make decisions that enhance efficiency.

4. Eco-Friendly Solution
Microtransit on-demand shared mobility services are designed to be environmentally sustainable. By aggregating multiple passengers into a single vehicle, they help reduce the total number of cars on the road, leading to lower greenhouse gas emissions and reduced traffic congestion. Many fleets also incorporate hybrid-electric vehicles to further minimize their carbon footprint. The fare structure is designed to be affordable, often more economical than ride-hailing services, while providing greater convenience than traditional buses.

5. Integration with Public Transit
Rather than replacing public transport systems, this service complements them. It functions as a bridge between fixed-route services and individualized transport, serving the “first mile” and “last mile” needs of commuters. What is VRT OnDemand?
VRT OnDemand is replacing the current ValleyRide fixed route bus system. VRT OnDemand will provide better transit flexibility than a traditional fixed route bus system. You will schedule a ride, when you need it. VRT OnDemand will not run on a set schedule and will expand the current service area. You will be able to book a trip between any two existing Valley Regional Transit bus stops or any of the virtual bus stops.
 
 
How do I pay?
You can purchase a pass at any of our outlets. You can pay with cash when on the bus when you board at the fare box. You can purchase a pass through our Valley Connect mobile app. More information on fares and passes can be found online at valleyregionaltransit.org.  
 
 
How long will I wait?
The drop off window is an estimate based on your desired travel time. Because this is a ride-sharing service, actual drop-off time may vary due to demand. Please understand that while we make every effort to arrive at your desired travel time, you may have a slight wait for the VRT OnDemand due to demand. If you must arrive at your destination at a specified time, we recommend planning your trip to arrive early.
 
 
When does VRT OnDemand operate?
VRT OnDemand runs Monday through Friday. You can request a ride by downloading the mobile app or by calling the Help Desk at 208-345-743. Please visit our website for more information valleyregionaltransit.org.

Ride Oswego County is an origin-to-destination specialized transportation service, operating in and around Oswego County.
 
Our vehicles are wheelchair accessible and are operated by specially-trained drivers. Whether you want to run an errand, visit a friend, or need reliable transit to recurring events (work, appointments, etc.), this service will get you there!
 
HOW IT WORKS:
- Book a ride on your smart phone by setting your pickup and dropoff addresses, and indicating if you’re riding with any additional passengers. You may also call a booking agent to book your trip over the phone. 
- Select the preferred pickup window for when the vehicle will arrive. You’re expected to be ready at any time during that pickup window. You’ll receive one automated call or text reminder for each trip you have scheduled, two days before your trip. 
- We’ll give you an automated call or send you a text notification when we’re nearby. 
- When your driver arrives, they will wait up to 5 minutes at your pickup location. If they arrive early, they will wait until the start of your pickup window, and then wait another 5 minutes. 
- If applicable, please pay your fare to the driver when you board the vehicle. Note that the driver does not have change. 
- There may be others on board, and you may make a few additional stops along the way! You can track your ride and share your status in real-time from the app. 
  
Questions? Reach out at rideoc@oswegocounty.com.
